skillFull: Moves ahead at regular intervals, singing a song and creating Harmony Jellies. Level Up for more points for Harmony Jellies.
story: Icy Birdie is renowned for singing the most beautiful tunes in Dessert Paradise. From the captivating crackling sounds like bubbly soda to the refreshing melodies that greet the early morning...! While singing many variations and impromptu pieces, one day, the Pet added a melody to Blue Slushy Cookie's words, crafting an extraordinary harmony. With both of them together, they could bask in the everlasting blessings of music!

costumes.name: Waltz of Ice Sculptures
costumes.info: To celebrate Blue Slushy Cookie becoming a Dessert Guardian, an ice sculpture festival was held! Icy Birdie busily flew between the sculptures, spreading the latest news about Cookies. The ice fragments drifting in the wind with every movement of Icy Birdie look like they are waltzing together!

costumes.name: Yakgwa Delivery Envoy
costumes.info: Icy Birdie was taking its sweet time picking out only the highest quality yakgwa when the exciting ba-dum thump thump of traditional janggu drums began echoing through the village. The energy was so infectious that the Pet began chirping to the rhythm, unable to stop even as it began its journey back to Dessert Paradise! Looks like a new track is being added to the music that echoes around the Dessert Paradise!

costumes.name: Cinematic Songster
costumes.info: The longest wait on set? It has to be the downtime. Waiting for Blue Slushy Cookie, Icy Birdie started singing and serenading, letting out a beautiful tune. It was a total mood lifter for the whole crew, and they just might have found the perfect background music for the next scene!
